sci.t_adv.bio-photosynthesis.calvin-cycl.claim: 碳反應（卡爾文循環／光獨立反應）在葉綠體基質（stroma）固定大氣 CO2 合成碳水化合物

refs.quote: In the stroma, in addition to CO2, two other components are present to initiate the light-independent reactions
light-independent reactions of photosynthesis that convert carbon dioxide from the atmosphere into carbohydrates

sci.t_adv.chem-bond.intermolecular.claim: 分子間作用力（凡得瓦力/偶極/氫鍵）決定沸點等整體物性，作用力愈強沸點愈高

refs.quote: Intermolecular forces determine bulk properties, such as the melting points of solids and the boiling points of liquids.
Trends in observed melting and boiling points for the halogens clearly demonstrate this effect, as seen in Table 10.1.

sci.t_adv.chem-bond.intermolecular.concern: OpenStax 該句以『this effect』指前文的分散力，標準但須配合上下文；LibreTexts 句較直接。

sci.t_adv.earth-climate.milankovitch.claim: 米蘭科維奇循環（地球軌道離心率、地軸傾角/obliquity、歲差的週期變化）影響氣候與冰期—間冰期

refs.quote: Larger tilt angles favor periods of deglaciation (the melting and retreat of glaciers and ice sheets).
The angle of tilt (also known as obliquity) varies on a time scale of 41,000 years.

sci.t_adv.earth-geomorph.sorting-roundin.claim: 沉積物淘選度反映搬運介質的能量；圓磨度反映磨蝕程度與搬運歷史（非單純等同搬運距離）

refs.quote: Sorting gives clues to the energy conditions of the transporting medium from which the sediment was deposited.
Conglomerates form in high-energy environments such as fast-flowing rivers, where the particles can become rounded.

sci.t_adv.earth-geomorph.sorting-roundin.concern: Tulane 同頁另有圓磨直接句：『Random abrasion results in the eventual rounding off of the sharp corners and edges of grains.』與『rounding of grains gives us clues to the amount of time a sediment has been in the transportation cycle.』可補強圓磨↔磨蝕/時間。

sci.t_adv.earth-geotime.earth-history-ev.claim: 地球歷史重大事件依序：最早的生命（原核生物）→大氣含氧上升→（後期中生代白堊紀末）恐龍滅絕

refs.quote: We now know that prokaryotes were likely the first forms of cellular life on Earth
Except for birds, dinosaurs became extinct at the end of the Cretaceous.

sci.t_adv.earth-geotime.earth-history-ev.concern: 難以單句同涵蓋完整序列；OpenStax 同頁另有含氧上升句（『Increased atmospheric oxygen allowed the evolution of more efficient O2-utilizing catabolic pathways』、『Early Earth had a very different atmosphere (contained less molecular oxygen) than it does today』），UCMP 提供恐龍白堊紀末滅絕，跨源拼出排序。

sci.t_adv.earth-tectonics.taiwan-orogeny.claim: 臺灣造山運動：弧陸碰撞（呂宋火山弧與歐亞大陸邊緣）使地層褶皺、抬升形成山脈（中央山脈）

refs.quote: The suture zones involve arc to continent collision, making thrust melts and young mountain ranges.
forced together by the collision of the forerunners of the Eurasian Plate and the Philippine Sea Plate

sci.t_adv.earth-tectonics.taiwan-orogeny.concern: 最難找源：Britannica 403、學術論文多半 paywall/不可抓；只湊到兩個百科類(wiki)可抓源，非白名單權威。建議日後以同儕審查文獻（如 Tectonics / 中研院地球所英文頁）替換。

sci.t_mid.chem-organic.carbon-idea.claim: 有機化合物與碳的特性：碳能與碳形成鏈/環及單、雙、三鍵；最簡單的有機物為僅含碳氫的烴

refs.quote: The simplest organic compounds contain only the elements carbon and hydrogen, and are called hydrocarbons.
Organic compounds that contain one or more double or triple bonds between carbon atoms are described as unsaturated.

sci.t_sub.bio-biodiversity.monophyletic.claim: 單系群（monophyletic group / clade）＝包含某最近共同祖先及其所有後代；與並系群、多系群區分

refs.quote: a group of organisms which includes the most recent common ancestor of all of its members
Consequently, all of these organisms also have amniotic eggs and make a single clade, also called a monophyletic group.

sci.t_sub.bio-biodiversity.monophyletic.concern: UCMP 同頁亦逐字區分並系（『includes the most recent common ancestor of all of its members, but not all of the descendants』）與多系（『does not include the most recent common ancestor of those organisms』），可補足三者對比。

sci.t_sub.bio-genetics-molecular.epigene.claim: 表觀遺傳：不改變 DNA 序列而影響基因表現（機制含 DNA 甲基化、組蛋白修飾）

refs.quote: a field of study focused on changes in DNA that do not involve alterations to the underlying sequence
Epigenetics is the study of how cells control gene activity without changing the DNA sequence.

sci.t_sub.bio-genetics-molecular.epigene.concern: 兩源皆明確支持『不改變序列』；甲基化/組蛋白修飾為同頁其他句之細節（非單句），教材敘述時另引。

sci.t_sub.chem-acidbase.lewis.claim: 路易斯酸鹼定義：路易斯酸＝電子對受體；路易斯鹼＝電子對予體

refs.quote: a substance that donates an unshared pair of electrons to a recipient species with which the electrons can be shared
The species accepting the electron pair is a Lewis acid, and the product of the reaction is a Lewis acid-base adduct

sci.t_sub.chem-applied.nanomaterials.claim: 奈米材料與新興材料初步：以奈米尺度（約 1–100 nm）計量的材料，於該尺度展現不同性質

refs.quote: Nanomaterials are partially characterized by their tiny particle size, measured in nanometers.
nanoparticles and nano-devices typically one hundred to ten thousand times smaller than human cells

sci.t_sub.chem-applied.nanomaterials.concern: 未找到逐字給『1–100 nm』或『新性質』之單句；FDA（https://www.fda.gov/.../nanotechnology-fact-sheet）另有『Nanomaterials ... are measured in nanometers — equal to about one-billionth of a meter』（含 em-dash，比對風險較高）可作第三源。

sci.t_sub.phys-em.em-wave-gen.claim: LC 振盪（能量在電容與電感間來回振盪）與電磁波的產生（振盪的電場、磁場垂直於傳播方向）

refs.quote: When fully charged, the capacitor once again transfers its energy to the inductor until it is again completely discharged
with its oscillating electric and magnetic fields perpendicular to its direction of propagation

sci.t_sub.phys-em.em-wave-gen.concern: ref1 支持 LC 振盪、ref2 支持電磁波性質；二者跨源合證命題，單句未同時含『LC 振盪產生電磁波』之機制。OpenStax 16-2 亦有同一電磁波句。

sci.t_sub.phys-estatic.rc-circuit.claim: RC 電路充放電：電荷/電流/電壓隨時間指數變化（時間常數 RC）

refs.quote: Note that the magnitudes of the charge, current, and voltage all decrease exponentially, approaching zero as time increases.
Note that the magnitudes of the charge, current, and voltage all decrease exponentially, approaching zero as time increases.

sci.t_sub.phys-heat.carnot.claim: 熱機效率與卡諾循環：卡諾循環是兩溫間效率最高的循環（兩等溫＋兩絕熱過程）

refs.quote: The most efficient heat engine cycle is the Carnot cycle, consisting of two isothermal processes and two adiabatic processes.
A Carnot engine has the maximum possible efficiency of converting heat into work between two reservoirs

sci.t_sub.phys-heat.entropy.claim: 熱力學第二定律與熵：封閉系統（及整個宇宙）的熵不會減少

refs.quote: The entropy of a closed system and the entire universe never decreases.
The entropy of a closed system and the entire universe never decreases.

soc-geo.t_adv.hum-transport.ict-space.claim: 資訊通訊科技（ICT）與數位落差：取得與使用數位科技/網路的不均落差

refs.quote: supports members in their efforts to bridge the digital divide and empower all people
The communities most affected by the digital divide are also among the most marginalized.

soc-geo.t_adv.hum-transport.ict-space.concern: 兩源皆述及『digital divide』但偏角色/後果，非嚴謹定義；OECD glossary(404)/OECD topics(403)/多 .gov 與教科書源不可抓。維基 Digital_divide 有較定義性句『Digital divide is inequitable access to and use of digital technology, encompassing…』可作替補。

soc-geo.t_sub.spatial-decision.data-ethi.claim: 空間資料倫理與隱私：定位/位置隱私（locational privacy）是空間資料處理的核心倫理議題

refs.quote: One of the most discussed topics concerns privacy, and in particular, what is referred to as locational privacy.
Preserving locational privacy is about maintaining dignity and confidence as you move through the world.
